item.title: [168] Shmup players are more likely to be psychopaths
item.description:
I have a Bachelor's degree in Psychology. And for fun, I have studied and interviewed various shmup players over the span of a few years. And the conclusion? Shmup players are more likely to have psychopathic traits. I will list them. If I documented this shit online you will find out who I am and I do not want to be harassed. Anyways, I did this for fun. Anyways..

They have lots of emotional detachment when facing hundreds, if not thousands of bullets on screen. And for people chasing big clears like 1CC, everything is COLDLY CALCULATED. you need to have razor sharp precision and accuracy in order to navigate your playthroughs. Some normal people experience anxiety, while others like shmup players feel a bit detached.

Another trait, they have a grandiose sense of superiority. Just look at the way people view scoring and achieving world records. It's all about bragging rights and recognition. Another trait that psychopaths absolutely love.

Pattern recognition. The ones who are very good at detecting certain patterns are usually very talented in the shmup genre. The ones who can read people end up finding bullet patterns fairly fast. Another high psychopathic trait.

Thrill seeking and very shallow. Obviously, shmup is extremely hardcore. Only the select few can achieve something as 1CC's or something crazier.. It's the thrill of dying at any moment. The closest thing a psychopath can get a rush out of. The thrill of losing any moment.

So if you have any of these traits as a shmup player you should seek a mental health professional and get it checked out. I will not drop names for their protection but I advised them the same thing. Anyways, if these clicked you may be a psychopath. Have a good day /v/.

item.title: [ 43] Rapist Refuses to Take No For an Answer
item.description:
https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jul/08/trump-e-jean-carroll-payment

Donald Trump’s latest effort to delay the release of more than $5m in court-held funds that he owes E Jean Carroll failed on Wednesday.

The US president asked Manhattan federal court judge Lewis Kaplan late on Tuesday not to order the release of these court-held funds, which a jury awarded Carroll in her successful 2023 sexual abuse and defamation civil trial against him; this money also includes interest. Trump has denied all wrongdoing.

Less than 24 hours later, Kaplan issued an order directing the disbursement of this money. Within an hour, Trump filed paperwork indicating that he is appealing this decision.

“The Clerk is respectfully directed to disburse … the value of the principle Judgment, which amounts to $5,000,000.00,” Kaplan’s order said. “The Clerk is further respectfully directed to disburse … the value of the post-judgment interest”.

Trump had deposited this multimillion jury award, plus 11% interest, into a court-controlled account about six weeks after Carroll’s win. For this money, which now totals about $5.8m, to be released, Kaplan had to order directing the court-controlled fund to do so.

Trump’s failed request stems from the supreme court’s 29 June decision not to review his appeal of this case. Trump had asked for the supreme court to weigh his appeal after lower courts repeatedly rejected his fight against this verdict.

After the supreme court denied hearing his appeal, Carroll’s legal team asked Manhattan federal court judge Lewis Kaplan to issue an order directing the release of these funds.

Donald Trump confirmed that he requested a review of last week’s red card penalty given to U.S. forward Folarin Balogun during the World Cup, saying the penalty was “very unfair” and the referee responsible is “very suspect.”

“I’m a person that loves sports and was a good athlete. And I understand sports really well. Really well. And that wasn’t a foul. That wasn’t even an infraction,” he told reporters at the White House.

Trump went on to say that he didn’t know what a red card was before the penalty against Balogun was made. Once he understood that it would take Balogun out of the next match, he personally intervened because “we have to have our best players.”

“All I did, all I did, I asked for a review ’cause I didn’t think it was a foul. And again, I’m good at this stuff. I didn’t think it was a foul. I thought it was two great athletes who crashed into each other and got entangled,” he said.

Trump also called into question the integrity of the referee, while offering no details to support the accusation.

“This referee, who is a little bit suspect if you check his past,” he said. “I don’t want to say that because I don’t like to create controversy. But very suspect.”

Trump’s confirmation of his intervention follows reports that he personally called FIFA President Gianni Infantino to review Balogun’s case. European soccer body UEFA on Monday said FIFA’s later decision to suspend the red card “crossed a red line.”

But other leaders have indeed already followed suit ― albeit so far only to make fun of both FIFA and Trump.

item.title: [124] /tpg/ - ThinkPad General
item.description:
>>109059453
Don't buy anything other than IBM/Lenovo ThinkPad T, X, and W/P Series if you want the Real Business Experience™
Other business laptops are welcome in /tpg/ (Dell Latitude/Precision, HP EliteBook/ZBook)

Why ThinkPad?
>Used machines are plentiful and cheap
>Utilitarian design: e.g. mix of old and new ports, stable keyboard layout
>Easy to repair, upgrade (some models) & maintain thanks to readily available service manuals, spare parts easy to obtain
>Usable in cramped quarters thanks to the TrackPoint
>Excellent Linux & *BSD support

ThinkWiki - General info
https://www.thinkwiki.org/

Model generations:
>Classic IBM: T40-T42
>IBM/Lenovo transition: T43 T60 T61 (T42-T43: significant spec difference; T43-T60: 64-bit arch)
>Classic Lenovo: T400-T430 (T61-T400: 4:3 to 16:10; T410-T420: 16:10 to 16:9; T420-T430: 6-row keyboard, USB 3)
>Boxy ultrabooks: T440-T480 (T430-T440: eDP, M.2, soldered CPU; T460-T470: NVMe, USB-C)
>Thin above all: T490 T14g1 T14g2 (T480-T490: soldered WiFi (Intel), partly soldered RAM, internal battery only)
>TrackPoint on a pig: T14g3 T14g4 (T14g2-T14g3: 16:9 to 16:10, fully soldered RAM/WiFi (AMD), end of mechanical docks)
>iFixit-approved TrackPoint on pig: T14g5-... (T14g4-T14g5: Ctrl/Fn swap, camera bump, modular RAM returns)

FAQ:
>Oldest that won't choke on the modern web
Light use: x60
YouTube, Gmail etc: xx00(s)
>Oldest that drives a 4K monitor
xx40(p/s)
>Oldest that takes 32 GB RAM
X260 T460p/s W510
>Lasts full day on battery
T550 T560 X260 xx70 Tx80 T16 and any Lunar Lake
>Newest with socketed CPU
T440p W541

item.description:
Jirachi Event is here

F.A.Q

Complete list of Pokémon here
https://www.serebii.net/pokemonpokopia/availablepokemon.shtml

>Can I have more than one world in the same console?
Yes. You can have different saves for each profile. It's not like AC.

>What about cloud saves?
Yes. Unlike every other Pokémon game, this one does support cloud saves.

>Does it feature a real time clock? Can I change the console's date to progress faster?
Yes. There's no downside to moving forward or backward.

>Is my favorite Pokemon in?
https://www.serebii.net/pokemonpokopia/availablepokemon.shtml

>I didn't like ACNH, will I like this one?
Similarities with ACNH end at the UI; game is a lot faster, with more activities and a proper ~40h long story mode. If you've played DQ Builders 2, you know what you're getting into.

>Combat? Breakable tools?
No combat, no breakable tools. There's a stamina system in place, but it's very easy to manage.

>Should I start building a mega project or finish the story?
FINISH THE STORY! Or, at the very least, complete Beach and Ridges.

item.title: [186] /pous/ Pokemon of Unusual Sizes General
item.description:
Welcome to the world of Pokemon of Unusual sizes! This is a monthly general where we post about, obviously, about Pokemon that have unusual sizes, whether Dynamaxed, Gigantamaxed, or under the effects of minimization. All types of Pokemon centric size shenanigans are welcome here.

Previous thread
https://arch.b4k.dev/vp/thread/59288620/


Basic etiquette:
>What if I want to post a human Pokegirl?
Images and stories should be Pokemon creature focused, if you want to post Pokegirl content, please post them in our sister thread

>What if I want to be overly horny?
This is a blue board, so try to keep things to blue board levels of horniness, if you want to over indulge, there's a size general on /trash/ to offramp. Or at least wait until there's 100 images in the thread or 151 posts in total.

>What if I don't like Pokemon of Unusual Sizes?
Then don't enter a thread of things that you specifically don't like and be angry when you see things you don't like?

>Isn't this a coy way to skirt around questionable content?
Ever since the introduction of size variances since Generation 7, with Totem pokemon, unusual sizes has been a regular and common place mechanic in Pokemon games, in the form of Dynamaxing, Alpha Pokemon, XS-XXL Pokemon, even introducing shrinking mechanics in New Pokemon Snap. It's 100% relevant to the Pokemon franchise, and their various mainline and side games.

Have fun, and look out below!

item.title: [141] ganja /out/ings
item.description:
This is a thread for enjoying a pipe while doing outdoor activities. If you ask why this belongs on /out/, you've never spent an evening by the campfire with a pipe or bowl or blunt or spliff or joint or vape or edible or dab or oil, silently enjoying the nature around you, and you're missing out.

>How to get started
Purchase a cheap glass pipe (or a simple wooden chillum) and a bag of some quality outdoor or mid-grade weed from a dispensary
or your usual guy. You will need a lighter and something to clear the bowl witha paperclip works well if you don't have a proper tool.
Pack the bowl loosely, enough for airflow but enough to stay lit. Light the corner of the bowl and inhale slow. Smoke
slower than you think you need to, the flower tastes best when it isn't cherried too hot. Tamp and corner or re-light as needed. If you still
have trouble, try different methods on YouTube until you find one that works for you. Or you can just roll it or whatever.

>smoking ganja will get you arrested
Originally, the government found that weed smokers, following a careful study of the statistics (at a time when hemp was a cash crop) were just peaceful people who wanted to grow their own medicine, enjoy jazz and engage in mild tomfoolery. Nowadays, weed is being legalized against while the average American thrashes in the thralls of poverty. Put two and two together. Marijuana is just another good thing that was under attack by the government.

>muh tobacco

All cannabis users welcome.
